change: Endless personal Raph clone pursuit; reveal the champion on the dais to start the duel automatically

dais.footprint: two columns by two rows, with adjacent Action interaction

rules.cloneSelection: At least five tiles away; avoids previous stop and immediate backtracking
rules.reveal: Action next to the concealed champion on the dais, no minimum number of clones; existing 960ms vanish/reappear animation, then automatic duel

savedState.legacy: unfinished v1 trail keeps its current stop; a completed v1 trail stays revealed; lazy transactionally persisted normalization

rules.collision: Only the clone is rendered before discovery; concealed dais interaction anchor remains personal and solid. Clone disappears from its old position on reveal.
rules.messages: four looping in-world lines, no promise of a final fourth encounter; historic entry speech untouched
rules.onceAndRewards: Existing requirements, victory/reward receipts, XP uniqueness, admin replay policy and follow-up dialogue retained; no account manually reset

implementation.rendering: Existing npcTeleport.js used unchanged; additive transition.kind clone/reveal and complete flag
implementation.adventure: Transactional per-user state; same-account sessions synchronized; existing guarded battle-completion function reused with server-created authorization on verified dais proximity
implementation.expeditions: Existing checkpoint carries personal state; transient reveal lock is a WeakSet outside serialization; revalidates socket, map, conscious/alive player, exploration phase and clock before duel
implementation.timing: Existing cooldown, no background loop. One bounded await during the reveal. Stale async continuations cannot start a duel after disconnect/leave/expiry.
implementation.isolation: Shared NPC store and Tiled/PNG maps untouched; clone positions and discovery isolated per player
implementation.client: No client modification or rebuild needed; currently deployed dialogue frame/gamepad/PWA build retained
